string.name: ToolTip
string.value: Effect Activation\r\nAfter you equip the effect, you can right-click the Equip Slot to toggle the effect on or off. \r\nThe Equip Slot will be green if the effect is on, and red if it is off.

string.name: Text00
string.value:
#eYou can earn Reward Points through gameplay in the following ways:#n
You can find Maple Rewards quests in the "Cash" section of the Quest Log under "In Progress".

string.name: Text01
string.value:
#b1. You can earn Reward Points once per level per account when your character reaches the following levels.#k
Lv. 70 - #b20#k Reward Points
Lv. 100 - #b50#k Reward Points
Lv. 150 - #b80#k Reward Points
Lv. 200 - #b150#k Reward Points
Lv. 210 - #b300#k Reward Points
Lv. 220 - #b500#k Reward Points
Lv. 230 - #b600#k Reward Points
Lv. 240 - #b700#k Reward Points
Lv. 250 - #b1,000#k Reward Points

string.name: Text02
string.value:
#b2. You can earn Reward Points once per day per boss for defeating the following bosses.#k
Earn #b50#k Reward Points when you beat Zakum, Chaos Zakum, Hilla, Hard Hilla, Horntail, Chaos Horntail, Von Leon, Arkarium, Pink Bean, Chaos Pink Bean, Cygnus, Magnus, Hard Magnus, Von Bon, Chaos Von Bon, Pierre, Chaos Pierre, Crimson Queen, Chaos Crimson Queen, Vellum, Chaos Vellum, Ranmaru, Hard Ranmaru, Princess No, or Gollux.
Earn #b20#k Reward Points when you beat Easy Magnus.

string.name: Text03
string.value:
#b3. You can earn Reward Points by defeating monsters in certain Party Quests, Theme Dungeons, and the Merchant Union Trade.#k
Earn #b40#k Reward Points when you beat Tarantulus.
Earn #b30#k Reward Points when you beat Demolishizer, Prison Guard Ani, Ephenia, Ravana, Angry Targa, Furious Scarboss, Emperor Toad, Grosso Polpo, Livyatan, Black Viking, or King Castle Golem.
Earn #b20#k Reward Points when you beat Mole King, Captain Darkgoo, Dragon Rider, Perfect Visitor, or Rex.
Earn #b10#k Reward Points when you beat Furious Targa, Furious Scarlion, or The Boss.
Earn #b5#k Reward Points when you beat Galacto-Drill.

string.name: Text04
string.value:
#b4. You can earn Reward Points by entering Monster Park multiple times.#k
Earn #b50#k Reward Points when you play Monster Park 5 times.
Earn #b150#k Reward Points when you play Monster Park 10 times.

string.name: Text05
string.value: To claim your Reward Points from the Maple Rewards quests, you must select the quest through the Maple Rewards notifier or the Quest Log, then click the #bFinish Quest#k button.

string.name: Text00
string.value: #bWhen you make purchases in the #bCash Shop#k, you will earn Reward Points equivalent to #b5% of the total amount of NX Prepaid or NX Credit spent#k.\r\n

string.name: Text01
string.value: You cannot earn Reward Points by purchasing gifts or gift-related items such as Friendship Rings, permanent items, or additional inventory and storage slots.

string.name: Text00
string.value: #eStoring Reward Points#n\r\n

string.name: Text01
string.value: 1. If you earn Reward Points through gameplay, you must claim and store them in the Cash Shop within #b7 days#k of earning them, or they will expire.\r\n\r\n

string.name: Text02
string.value: 2. You can use your Reward Points #bfrom the date you claim and store them in the Cash Shop until the end of the following month at 11:59 PM UTC#k. After that, they will expire. For example, Maple Rewards earned in May can be used until June 30 at 11:59 PM UTC.\r\n\r\n

string.name: Text03
string.value: 3. You may earn Reward Points through gameplay #bup to 20 times per account#k.\r\n\r\n

string.name: Text04
string.value: 4. Once you stop earning Reward Points, you must claim and store your points in the Cash Shop before you can earn more.

string.name: Text05
string.value: #eUsing Reward Points#n\r\n

string.name: Text06
string.value: 1. You can use your Reward Points for up to #b30%#k of certain Cash Shop purchases. You must have 30% or more of the purchase price in Reward Points in order to apply your points to the purchase.\r\n\r\n

string.name: Text07
string.value:
2. You cannot use Reward Points toward the following Cash Shop purchases: 
Pet and Equipment Cover Packages, Royal Hair and Face Coupons, All-Star Hair Coupons, Beauty Salon Hair and Face Slot Coupons, 2x EXP Coupons, 2x Drop Coupons, Androids and any Android-related items such as Hearts and Naming Coupons, Scissors of Karma and Platinum Scissors of Karma, Sharing Tags, Monster Life Gems Coupons, any Surprise Boxes, Philosopher's Books, Gachapon Tickets, Red Leaf High Entry Keys, Maple Leaf High Special Class Key, Sengoku Class Supplementary Pass, Meso Sacks, Premium Pet Food, Shadow Style, Return of Angel Wing, or any Inventory or Storage slots.
The list of Cash Shop items that cannot be purchased with Reward Points may be updated in the future.

string.name: Text09
string.value: 3. You can also use your Reward Points in the #bMaple Rewards Shop.#k To enter the shop, first enter the Cash Shop, then click the "Maple Rewards Shop" button. You can only purchase items in the Maple Rewards Shop with Reward Points. The number of items you can purchase in the Maple Rewards Shop is #blimited by account#k. These purchase limits reset on the #bfirst day of every month.#k

string.name: Text10
string.value: #eReward Points Limits#n\r\n

string.name: Text11
string.value: 1. You can earn up to #b3,000#k Reward Points per world per day from #bParty Quests, Theme Dungeons, Bosses, and leveling#k.\r\n

string.name: Text12
string.value: 2. You can earn up to #b3,000#k Reward Points per account per day from #bParty Quests, Theme Dungeons, Bosses, and leveling#k.\r\n

string.name: Text13
string.value: 3. You can earn up to #b45,000#k Reward Points per account per month from #bParty Quests, Theme Dungeons, Bosses, and leveling#k.\r\n

string.name: Text14
string.value: 4. You can earn up to #b200,000#k Reward Points per account per month. You cannot earn additional Reward Points if the total will exceed any of the limits.

string.name: Text15
string.value: 4. You can earn up to #b200,000#k Reward Points per account per month. You cannot earn additional Reward Points if the total will exceed any of the limits.
